url.description:
The path to save to when the file is saved. This should be an encoded file name, which cannot have spaces in it.
e.g. "raw file.json" should passed as "raw%20file.json"

isCopy.description: If the upload operation is for copying file

numRetries.description: The maximum number of retries when reading the content part with exponential backoff
